nodes.name: Open CEDA

nodes.sector: 400 economic sectors and global supply-chain greenhouse-gas intensities

nodes.name: EXIOBASE 3

nodes.name: US Environmentally-Extended Input-Output models
nodes.geography: United States with imported-impact extensions in some variants
nodes.sector: US economy; official page describes 389 industry sectors

nodes.name: Cornerstone Sustainability Data Hub

relationships.evidence: Both provide multiregional environmentally extended input-output data for supply-chain analysis.
relationships.constraints: Coverage, classifications, base years and extensions differ.

relationships.evidence: Both support spend-based life-cycle and Scope 3 analysis.
relationships.constraints: One is global MR-EEIO and the other is US-specific with different classifications.
relationships.validation_question: Do not mix factors without currency and sector harmonization.

relationships.evidence: Cornerstone lists CEDA as one of its maintained downloadable core datasets.
relationships.constraints: The enterprise CEDA service and public Open CEDA release have different terms.
relationships.validation_question: Preserve release, licence and distribution channel.
